title: BRE-13: Mediterranean Diet
official: BRE-13: Mediterranean Diet-A Presurgical Window of Opportunity Trial Among Women With Breast Cancer
summary: Explore the effect of MedDiet vs. Usual Diet on circulating and breast tumor fatty acid profiles. The investigators aim to examine impact on tumor biology in newly diagnosed participants.
